item.title: Federal judge issues preliminary injunction keeping Trump media ban blocked
item.description: The same judge had issued a temporary restraining order last month.

item.title: Iowa confronts water quality and cancer rates in midterm races
item.description: Water quality and cancer rates are emerging as central issues in Iowa's state politics.

item.title: Trump: Greenland oil, gas and mineral exploration set to begin
item.description: The announcement follows a U.S. agreement with Greenland and Denmark by four weeks to strengthen American military presence on the island.

item.title: Cornell faculty to debate no-confidence resolution
item.description: Cornell University's faculty senate will begin deliberating a no-confidence resolution on Wednesday to condemn the school's response to sexual violence.
